data.action: 穿白无垢和角隐站在雪庭木廊前，双手交叠腹前微微行礼，再抬眼浅笑。
data.camera: medium full shot, eye level, formal bridal portrait
data.description: 两仪家冬日庭院积着薄雪，古松与竹影围住安静的木廊。两仪式换上纯白无垢，角隐覆在短发上，织纹在雪地反光中若隐若现。她把双手端正交叠在腹前，向廊下的你微微躬身，平日冷静的神情里多了一点羞意。她抬眼时露出克制而认真的微笑，雪光映亮了角隐的边缘。
data.location: 两仪家大宅白雪覆盖的枯山水古庭长廊前
data.promptProse: White silk catches the reflected snow light as Ryougi Shiki bows slightly before the wooden veranda of the Ryougi estate. She wears a complete shiromuku and white tsunokakushi, with both hands folded neatly at her waist. Her short black hair frames a restrained, bashful smile as she raises her eyes toward the viewer. Frosted bamboo and an old pine enclose the quiet courtyard. The formal white layers and folded hands define this quiet portrait.
data.title: 两仪式 · 幽雪两仪的真白无垢
